title: Help topics
intro: Short answers about using this app. They are not medical advice.

reviewed.question: What does 'Reviewed' mean?
reviewed.answer: Someone on your care team has looked at the result. The app only shows results your care team has checked.

latestCheck.question: Why can't I see my latest check?
latestCheck.answer: A new check appears after your care team has reviewed it. Until then the Timeline shows that it is waiting.

stopReminders.question: How do I stop reminders?
stopReminders.answer: Open Reminders, then Reminder settings, and turn reminders off. You can turn them on again at any time.

demoPersona.question: What is a demo persona?
demoPersona.answer: A demo persona is a made-up person you can try this app as. It is not a real sign-in, and none of the information is real.

correction.question: How do I ask for a correction?
correction.answer: If something in your record looks wrong, you can ask your care team to check it. Asking does not change your record.
